items.text: Collaborate with DT offices and customers to design and implement data, voice, radio, broadcast media distribution, and network solutions in compliance with DoS architecture and design standards. Participate in planning and delivery of network support services.
Maintain documentation of network port configurations and physical network layouts, including cabling, telecom closets, main distribution facilities, and server rooms.

Install and upgrade IT infrastructure including network, voice, television/media cabling, provider circuits, wireless and cellular networks, satellite connectivity, radio systems, and voice communication systems.

Install, configure, optimize, and replace: 1.) network security appliances including firewalls and Virtual Private Network (VPN) devices 2.) routers, switches, and firewalls, ensuring current firmware and operating system software 3.) wireless technology equipment supporting DoS Enterprise Wi-Fi, Non-Enterprise Wi-Fi, and official residence systems.
Monitor network capacity and performance and proactively resolve incidents.
Evaluate, configure, secure, and maintain network consolidation and bandwidth optimization systems supporting DoS and tenant agencies.
Troubleshoot network issues, conduct root cause analysis, document resolutions, and recommend system improvements.
Develop and implement network backup and recovery operations and ensure backup systems are periodically tested.

Conduct routine monitoring and preventive maintenance in DT processing spaces, including system backups, facility checks, and updates to network switches, PBX, voicemail, call routing, radio repeaters, radio over IP, and television/media distribution systems.
Develop professional skills through formal training and independent study. Cross-train backup staff and coordinate leave schedules to ensure continuity of operations.
Mentor DT staff by sharing troubleshooting methods, automationing techniques, and technical expertise.

Develop and document solutions supporting customer productivity. Maintain knowledgebase articles, workstation and network documentation, user information, configurations, cabling records, and trouble logs.

Use tools such as iPost and Splunk to monitor network and server integrity. Assist the Information System Security Officer (ISSO) with maintenance of unclassified networks, installation of required patches, and compliance with cybersecurity requirements.
Assist ISSO with cybersecurity awareness training and follow all USG, Department, and Mission cybersecurity policies to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of IT resources.
Provide IT support for VIP and VVIP visits, including communication systems and high-speed internet connectivity at hotels and event sites.
Manage or participate in projects under DT project managers by performing assigned technical and administrative duties.
Provide budget estimates, timelines, progress updates, lifecycle replacement planning, procurement support, and project documentation.
Prioritize and coordinate project activities across missions and track milestones.
Assist DT teams in identifying technology solutions that improve Mission operations, security, efficiency, and innovation.
Perform asset management and IT inventory support, including barcode scanning, equipment inspections, and locating missing items.

Note: This position description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the incumbent. Incumbent will be required to perform other duties as assigned by the agency.
